method: Registry compressed bytes multiplied by the measured pinned-22 Docker/compressed ratio; exact pinned Hub file sizes added by task. Planning estimate, not a full image pull.
shard_target_basis: 100 GB keeps projected shards below the measured 256 GiB changed-data cap and, using shard-03's measured 3.04M inodes at 415 GB as a conservative linear calibration, below the measured 1,000,101-inode passing probe. The 1,500,151-inode probe failed at only 30 GB.
